title: Review Package and Versioned Reproduction
paragraphs: Appendix L Review Package and Versioned Reproduction The reviewer directory is a curated copy of available materials, not a claim that missing evidence has been recovered. Its index and checksummed manifest identify included les, unavailable artifacts, and verication status. Source text, compiled output when available, reference records, diagrams, input schemas, and reproducibility utilities are supplied without editorial scratch les. Methodological disclosure and the planned experiment protocol remain part of the scientic record. L.1 Available and Pending Evidence Thesis and diagrams LaTeX sources, native vector diagrams, portable Mermaid sources, and the compiled PDF when compilation succeeds. Reported results Historical numerical tables already present in the thesis, explicitly distinguished from newly recomputed results. Field evidence: available Original 60-row questionnaire responses, the reconstructed 52-row analysis matrix, and the exclusion key. Instrument provenance, signed consent records, 313

APPENDIX L. REVIEW PACKAGE AND VERSIONED REPRODUCTION 314 and independently keyed factual answers remain pending. FGD transcript: available The original 160-segment transcript, the four-domain synthesis in Appendix G, and the design-only simulation bundle. The audiovisual recordings and participant roster remain unavailable; disputed candidate quotations remain outside participant datasets. Qualitative evidence: available Pseudonymised ride/PO accounts, the researcher self-report audio and its 185segment GPU transcript, coding decisions, and the four qualitative corpora. Participant recordings and the focus-group roster remain unavailable. Context and corpus: available Four corpora (Uber reviews, student social-media, student-lifestyle, Reuters DNR manifest). Uber statements, linkage documentation, usage permissions, and independently adjudicated factual keys remain pending. Historical software: partially available The v8 pipeline, environment record, seeds, posterior draws, execution logs, and generated outputs are included. The original platform backend and client sources remain pending. Identiable records are not automatically copied to the reviewer package. An explicit source-register release decision is required; approval to conduct research is not automatically permission for unrestricted le distribution.

APPENDIX L. REVIEW PACKAGE AND VERSIONED REPRODUCTION 315 L.2 Regeneration Without Silent Changes From the project root, run python 02_code/pipeline/loklok_pipeline_v8.py root . embedding-model BAAI/bge-m3 device cuda The workow validates input schemas and records le hashes. New approved survey records produce a separately labelled update appendix with actual sample counts, scoring rules, missingness, descriptive statistics, reliability, and correlations. Historical numbers remain a historical baseline: no script silently rewrites the meaning of an earlier dataset or claims to repeat a model whose code is absent. Each changed input creates a new content-addressed snapshot. Manuscript interpretation still requires researcher review. The source register records evidence type, le location, provenance, verication, and release status. A focus-group record cannot be promoted to factual ground truth merely by changing its lename. New qualitative content requires documented coding decisions; the pipeline does not automatically invent themes or quotations. Additional analyses become executable only when the corresponding validated estimator and inputs are supplied. L.3 Research Notes and Graph The linked-note graph separates theory, variables, observations, model outputs, and pending evidence. Its editable JSON notes have stable identiers, source pointers, and explicit relationships. An oine HTML graph and portable Mermaid source

APPENDIX L. REVIEW PACKAGE AND VERSIONED REPRODUCTION 316 are generated from those same records. Notes assist navigation; their links are not empirical causal estimates. L.4 Submission Checks The manuscript uses authordate references, a hanging-indent reference list, numbered chapters and equations, lists of tables and gures, and separated appendices. The ocial Ahram Canadian University programme handbook, approved title wording, committee forms, ethics documentation, abstract-length rules, and submission requirements have not been supplied. A similarly named institution's handbook is not substituted. Formatting here is therefore a working thesis format, not certication of institutional compliance.
